subject: MedForge renewal: commissioning additional isolated enclaves & term recast
messages:
From: Bryce Lynch <bryce@medforge.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anna Morales <anna.morales@medforge.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: MedForge renewal & VPC isolation request

Sofia — thanks for the catch-up last quarter. Our renewal is up Nov 15 and we've run into two items we want scoped into the renewal instead of handling as separate tickets: 1) commission two additional isolated enclaves (one for analytics/PHI processing, one for a security sandbox) inside our existing private VPC; 2) extend the term and align provisioning schedule so we can stagger cutovers across regions.

High level asks:
- Provision 2 x isolated enclaves (same sizing as our current analytics cluster) behind strict network isolation and separate audit logging retention.
- Expected steady-state: ~250 qps of short-sequence generation (avg 32 tokens), with occasional batch reports hitting sustained 650 qps for hour-long windows during spikes.
- We need 90-day retention of audit logs for the new enclaves and separate KMS keys.

Please send a proposal with timelines and a commercial for term options — we are open to an 18-month or 24-month renewal if it helps to amortize the provisioning uplift. Procurement (cc) will want an SOW and a capacity breakdown.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

— Bryce
Bryce Lynch
Head of Platform Engineering, MedForge Health

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bryce Lynch <bryce@medforge.com>
Cc: Anna Morales <anna.morales@medforge.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedForge renewal & VPC isolation request

Bryce — appreciate the detail, this is doable. I've looped in Priyom (solutions) and Karthik (onprem ops) to size a scoped SOW and delivery plan. A few quick clarifying questions so we size correctly:

- For the "same sizing as current analytics cluster," can you confirm current GPU type (V100 vs A100) and node count per enclave?
- During the sustained 650 qps spike windows, what percentage of requests are streaming vs non-streaming? That affects batching policy and node count estimates.
- For the KMS keys: is MedForge planning to provision customer-managed keys (CMK) in the same region, or do you want Redwood-managed keys with separate key wrapping?

I'll have a draft SOW and a capacity breakdown spreadsheet to you by EOD Friday (attached: first-pass SOW_v0.1). If an 18- or 24-month term is preferable, we can present both price curves.

Would you be available Wed 10/7 10:00–10:30 PT for a quick alignment call? If not, share a couple slots and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FW: MedForge renewal & VPC isolation request — sizing & commercial ask

Team — forwarding Bryce's note. MedForge wants to fold two additional isolated enclaves into their Nov 15 renewal and is open to an 18/24m term to smooth cost. Procurement will need an SOW + itemized capacity workbook.

Proposal draft outline (please review):
- Provisioning: 2 x isolated enclaves, each matching current analytics profile (assume A100 x8 per enclave by default). If they confirm V100 we adjust down.
- Capacity for steady-state: plan for 250 qps avg (32 tokens) with 1x reserve headroom; spike capacity sizing to sustain 650 qps for 1–2 hour windows via burst nodes + temporary autoscale.
- Storage & logs: separate logging bucket per enclave, 90-day retention (in scope), CMK integration (customer-managed preferred).
- Service & delivery: staging cutover for enclave A (US-East) in month 1, enclave B (EU) month 3; legal addendum to include enclave-level audit obligations and SLA for provisioned nodes.
- Commercial: propose two pricing options — (A) 18-month term with 12% uplift on annual list for capacity add-ons; (B) 24-month term with 7% uplift. Include one-time provisioning fee to cover isolation setup and KMS integration (estimate $25k).

Attachments: SOW_MedForge_v2.pdf (draft), capacity_breakdown.xlsx (workbook with node counts and cost math).

Questions / asks:
- Priyom: confirm provisioning fee estimate and whether we should include a phased invoice schedule tied to cutover milestones.
- Kimberly: legal — are there any new audit language/terms we should pre-empt for enclave-level isolation (KMS + 90-day retention)?
- Karthik: ops — confirm 8x A100 per enclave assumption and confirm our ability to guarantee burst headroom to 650 qps without impacting existing footprint.

I plan to turn this into a customer-facing SOW and pricing sheet once we align internally. Aim to have a customer send by EOD Friday.

Thanks — Sofia

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Bryce Lynch <bryce@medforge.com>
Cc: Anna Morales <anna.morales@medforge.com>, MedForge Procurement <procurement@medforge.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MedForge renewal: commissioning additional isolated enclaves & term recast

Bryce — thanks for the details on the call last week. Attached is the SOW we discussed (SOW_MedForge_v2.pdf) and the capacity workbook (capacity_breakdown.xlsx). Summary of the proposal: 

- Scope: 2x isolated enclaves (analytics + security sandbox) provisioned as separate VPC enclaves with dedicated audit logs and KMS per enclave.
- Timeline: enclave A (US-East) provisioned week 2 after signature; enclave B (EU) provisioned week 10 (staged cutover to avoid cross-region conflicts).
- Term / pricing: we provided two commercial options in the SOW — 18-month term (12% uplift on renewed base) or 24-month term (7% uplift). One-time provisioning fee: $25,000 (covers isolation set-up and KMS integration).
- Capacity guarantees: steady-state capacity to handle 250 qps (32 tokens avg) plus provisioned burst nodes to support sustained 650 qps windows for up to 2 hours; SLA language for capacity fallback is in section 4.2 of the SOW.

Next steps: please review SOW + workbook and confirm which term you prefer. If Procurement is ready, we can route the SOW to DocuSign and start the phased invoicing tied to cutover milestones (50% on signature, 25% on enclave A provision, 25% on enclave B provision).

If this aligns, we'll get the DocuSign link out today so you can circulate internally. Happy to run through the SOW with procurement on a short call — let me know a time.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
